places.name: Ashen Tower

why.founding: The road villages on the fringe keep the Argonian calendar on Imperial ground. For one month of the twelve the road villages between Gideon and the Onkobra empty out onto this flat. They hold Moonmarch there. During the other eleven months the flat is a field with post-holes in it.
why.siteAdvantages: The site is a wide dry flat that the monsoon does not reach. It lies close enough to three villages that the dancers walk home the same night. It lies far enough from Gideon that the magistracy does not attend.
why.occupantsMotive: The ground-keeper's family holds the flat in order to keep it unbuilt. Their claim is older than the Imperial title that governs the flat.
why.pressures: Gideon's clerks have twice tried to license the gathering. Both times the villagers said there is no roof here to license. A Nibenese landowner has started grazing the flat out of season to establish use.
why.wouldChangeIf: The ground would become a permanent fairground if a roof went up over it.
